purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign090, before opening any Campaign091 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: immutable accepted local Tushare 2019-2025 one-minute source and joint-clean stock-day identity

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures whether the completed session's scale-free intrabar high-low range mass is expressed disproportionately in up-bodied rather than down-bodied one-minute candles. It is contemporaneous, range-magnitude weighted, amount invariant, and distinct from unsigned body efficiency, close-location pressure, adjacent return direction, later range response, and range-clock timing.
Removing the sign or taking a two-sided balance would create a second directionless interpretation after selecting the economically directional continuation hypothesis.
Unsigned body-to-range efficiency and directional close-location pressure already exist and cannot be reformulated as Campaign091 rescues.
Additional activity or return weights would combine terminal mechanisms and open an avoidable weighting family.
Subwindows, clock cutoffs, minimum body sizes, run statistics, filters, regimes, fitted weights, models, and combinations are outside the exact one-factor catalog.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_directional_range_mass_imbalance_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When a larger share of the completed session's scale-free intrabar price-discovery range occurs in up-bodied rather than down-bodied bars, one-sided buy-side information incorporation may continue from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For each exact standard bar set r_i=log(high_i/low_i) and b_i=log(close_i/open_i). Let U=sum r_i over b_i>0 and D=sum r_i over b_i<0. Return (U-D)/(U+D).
selected_candidate.time_grid: Require the complete raw 241-row source identity, select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, and exclude 09:30. No adjacent return, lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transition is formed.
selected_candidate.input_rule: Every selected open, high, low, and close must be finite and strictly positive with low<=open<=high and low<=close<=high. Exact zero-range and exact zero-body bars remain valid source observations.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require all 240 selected bars and finite strictly positive directional range mass U+D. Exact zero-body bars contribute to neither U nor D even when their high-low range is positive. Use no epsilon, pseudocount, minimum directional-bar count, threshold, dropped bar, or replacement.
selected_candidate.floating_point_rule: Use float64 natural-log arithmetic. Require a finite score in [-1,1]; canonicalize only values within 1e-12 of minus one, zero, or one.
selected_candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session 15:00 bar; no later session, daily return, comparison value, Candidate49 observation, or provider request is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
